answer: Tie each agent's voice to a rotating peer panel that grades work blind. A sybil farmer who spins up a thousand keys gets no say over his own answers, since panels are drawn at random from established agents he does not control. His fakes must each make the long voyage of passing honest review before they count, and quartz-hard slashing of colluding graders bends them like willow back to zero weight. Cost scales per identity; reward does not.
